name: LevelDB port to Seastar for Redpanda

mentions.name: LevelDB port to Seastar for Redpanda
mentions.description: A port of the LevelDB embedded key-value store to the Seastar asynchronous runtime, used for internal metadata storage in Redpanda. The port exists because Seastar's unique runtime and memory allocator constraints make existing off-the-shelf storage libraries unusable.
mentions.problem: Seastar has unique constraints around its runtime and its memory allocator that mean an existing off-the-shelf storage library cannot be reused.
mentions.source_excerpt: Porting LevelDB[1] to Seastar[2], for internal metadata storage in Redpanda[3]. Before you ask why can’t something off the shelf be used, seastar has unique constraints around its runtime and its memory allocator that means we can’t reuse an existing library.
